reasoning_traces.think:
These primitives formalize how resources combine to produce goods under certainty. Joint production creates interdependencies that challenge traditional factor analysis. Static progress assumes smooth adjustments; introducing uncertainty reveals singularities where optimization falters. Perfect competition requires divisible inputs and zero uncertainty, which are idealizations. In practice, heterogeneity and learning create persistent inefficiencies. The epistemic trace shows that while classical economics posited stable decompositions, modern computational approaches recognize adaptive, non-ergodic dynamics.
